facts.fact: 1. 同谋曝光：Kieran/Mara 在车上密谈—— predicament 相同（Zach 错过 Ursids）——Kieran 的秘密短信原来是 Mara；Girlfriend? 回声再响。
2. 手纹划过：Who did you think I was talking to?——Kieran 指尖轻划掌纹。
3. 车内五分钟：forest path 口停车、两人下车支开 Zach——等五分钟再沿小径直走后院；Cheek kiss（like he's done it a million times）——My master plan。
4. Seth 终局：四分四十五秒手机响——green heart；这通电话照旧 on Seth's terms（因为 Seth 想要）——决定性按下 months ago 就该按的按钮：Block caller。然后下车。
5. 烟花替身：灯笼小径、lake house 窗光、冻湖晨光——gunshot 吓跳——Fireworks：It's not quite a meteor shower. But I thought this might be a close second。
6. 爱的计价：Tove/Mara 在屋檐下布场——All I had to do was supply the fireworks——Did you even know how much they love you?（fingertips 触脸）——I'm a very, very lucky guy。
7. 呼应桥段：Shut up. Stop talking——Terribly rude. Extraordinarily rude, even（grin as wide as the night）——arms around neck。
8. 终章之吻：This kiss, under the dazzling lights of the best Ursid display of his life, takes no bravery at all。
